declared: 2026-11-10, P1-5 T5.12 (docs/reports/rl_ready/P1_5_PLAN.md section 5), before any smoke run. No training and no gradient step; a smoke is never a benchmark row. Changes are a new versioned file.
consumer_check: scripts/rl_ready/check_rl_rollout.py (PASS/FAIL per item; exit code 0 alone is not a pass)

common.runtime: rl_gpu_headless, one process, one VectorCuttingEnv (one material, one device HashGrid), no Kit
common.evaluation: evaluate(episode='last_completed') for every TRUNCATED_TIME_LIMIT / TERMINATED_INVALID episode (two-frame mode; host, outside timing); forced-reset episodes are not evaluated
common.forced_resets: random envs only: gaps uniform in [50, 300] steps from SplitMix64(forced_reset_seed, env, counter); the writer marks the last stored transition truncated (TRUNCATED_BY_FORCED_RESET) and stores the pre-reset observation as next_obs

runs.reduced_fidelity: workload A labels (ideal tracking, no robot, handle box only)
C2 labels (ideal tracking, no robot, handle box only)
